elements.element: Mutual aggregate cap applying to each Party
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed"

elements.element: Cap set at the greater of the two limbs
elements.evidence: "shall not exceed the greater of (i) ... and (ii) USD 1,000,000"

elements.element: Fee limb = fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim

elements.evidence: "Customer's payment obligations under this Agreement are not damages for purposes of this cap."
greater-of cap includes the 12-month fee limb and applies to "each Party"

elements.element: Carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct

reasons: The inserted subsection (b) supplies every preferred atomic element: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, the full uncapped carve-out list (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), and the payment-obligations carve-out.
The existing mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages in (a) is left untouched and continues to satisfy that element.
The change is a single concise insertion addressing an absent cap; no other terms are rewritten and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced ('Excluded Claims' is defined in-line).
